g.text: RR1/RR2: EVPN route reflectors with dedicated /31 uplinks to both spines
SPINE1/SPINE2: underlay transit and RR fanout; no tenant gateways
LEAF1/2: POD1 MLAG pair serving GPU-A and GPU-C dual-homed Ubuntu VMs
LEAF3/4: POD2 MLAG pair serving GPU-B and STORAGE dual-homed Ubuntu VMs
BL1/BL2: border MLAG pair for services VLAN130, collector access, and eBGP edge
GPU-A eth0 -> LEAF1 E20 | eth1 -> LEAF2 E20 | Port-Channel10 | VLAN110
GPU-C eth0 -> LEAF1 E21 | eth1 -> LEAF2 E21 | Port-Channel11 | VLAN210
GPU-B eth0 -> LEAF3 E20 | eth1 -> LEAF4 E20 | Port-Channel20 | VLAN110
STORAGE eth0 -> LEAF3 E21 | eth1 -> LEAF4 E21 | Port-Channel21 | VLAN120
COLLECTOR eth0 -> BL1 E20 | eth1 -> BL2 E20 | Port-Channel30 | VLAN130
Peer-links: LEAF1/2 E10-E11, LEAF3/4 E10-E11, BL1/2 E10-E11 -> Port-Channel100
POD1 shared VTEP: LEAF1 Lo2 + LEAF2 Lo2 = 10.254.12.12
POD2 shared VTEP: LEAF3 Lo2 + LEAF4 Lo2 = 10.254.34.34
BORDER shared VTEP: BL1 Lo2 + BL2 Lo2 = 10.254.78.78
